blocks.text: Kokosnødder sælges på to stadier: unge (grønne) nødder med mest kokosvand og lidt geléagtigt kød, og modne nødder med det hårde, hvide kød. Ryst nødden – der skal kunne høres vand.

sourceRef.locator: Coconut chapter, Scientific Name and Introduction; Quality Characteristics and Criteria, p. 294
sourceRef.quote: Coconut (Cocos nucifera L.) is marketed at two stages of development. At an immature stage, the fruit (water coconut) contains mainly water and a little jellylike meat instead of the hard, white flesh (meat/endosperm) found in mature coconuts. … Check for a sloshing sound for presence of coconut water in the nut.

blocks.text: Modne kokosnødder med skal kan ligge ved stuetemperatur i 3–5 måneder, før vandet fordamper, eller skallen revner eller spirer. Undgå tør luft og høj varme.

sourceRef.locator: Coconut chapter, Optimum Storage Conditions, p. 295
sourceRef.quote: Mature coconuts with husk can be kept at ambient conditions for 3 to 5 mo before the liquid endosperm evaporates or before the shell cracks due to desiccation or sprouting. … Low RH and high temperature should be avoided.

blocks.text: Pludselige temperaturskift på 8 °C eller mere kan få modne kokosnødder til at revne. De fryser ved −3 °C.

sourceRef.quote: A rapid temperature change of 8 °C (15 °F) or more during storage of mature husked coconut can lead to cracking (Burton 1982), while freezing occurs at -3 °C (27 °F).

blocks.text: Modne kokosnødder danner næsten ingen ethylen (en gas, som frugt og grønt selv afgiver, og som får dem til at modne), og der er ingen kendt følsomhed over for ethylen.

sourceRef.locator: Coconut chapter, Ethylene Production and Sensitivity, p. 295
sourceRef.quote: Ethylene production is very low to near zero for mature husked coconut. There are no reports of sensitivity to ethylene.

blocks.text: Afskallede, modne kokosnødder kan holde op til 60 dage ved 0–1,5 °C og 75–85 % luftfugtighed. Unge kokosnødder holdes ved 3–6 °C.

sourceRef.locator: Coconut chapter, Optimum Storage Conditions, p. 295
sourceRef.quote: Storage at 0 to 1.5 ºC (32 to 35 ºF) and 75 to 85% RH is possible for up to 60 days for mature, dehusked coconuts … Young coconuts are normally held at 3 to 6 ºC (37 to 43 ºF) with 90 to 95% RH
